stages.title: Design
stages.condition: the client receives the design files for five pages
stages.source: The first stage of 10000 rupees for design is released once the client receives the design files for five pages.

stages.title: Development
stages.condition: all web pages are deployed to the staging server and working
stages.source: The second stage of 15000 rupees for development is released when all web pages are deployed to the staging server and working.

stages.title: Launch
stages.condition: the website is deployed to the production domain and accessible publicly
stages.source: The final stage of 5000 rupees for launch is released once the website is deployed to the production domain and accessible publicly.
